answer: Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 23 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. Because the nebula stamp is verified against the raven nonce, the saffron audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. A farm hence burns the hashing cost per key per epoch, which is a linear compute bill rather than a one-off build. A 186 account operation therefore ties up 24 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
